scope: Prospective production mesh selection amendment; running source and fixed comparison gates unchanged
rule: A scene may select either member of its first passing mesh pair that exactly nests the common predictor4 mesh. Prefer the lower nested member; if only the upper nests, choose that upper member (e.g. 10/12 -> 12). The fixed symmetric pair-difference gates apply unchanged to both materials and both sparse/dense physical observations.
claim: Two-resolution consistency within predeclared tolerances, not a mathematical convergence proof or extrapolated truth.
additional_requirements: Chosen mesh endpoint stability and penetration
All five scenes and both development materials, including dynamic body centers
Independent contact and sphere integration checks
timing: Declared before higher-ladder comparison outcomes were written. Existing lower-mesh candidate field remains as historical algorithm output; production mesh selection is reported separately.
